note: Part-specific household refs for the european-american part; grams per unit are USDA household-measure standards, cited in basis. Suite refs are never redefined here.

lemon_juice_tbsp.basis: 1 US tbsp = 15 ml; citrus juice ~1 g/ml (USDA household)

tomato_puree_cup.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 cup tomato puree ~226 g

water_cup.basis: 1 US cup water ~240 g (water ~1 g/ml; US legal cup 240 ml)

barley_cup.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 cup raw pearled barley ~200 g

mayonnaise_tbsp.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 tbsp mayonnaise ~14 g

sour_cream_tbsp.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 tbsp sour cream ~15 g

celery_stalk.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 medium celery stalk ~40 g

chives_tbsp.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 tbsp chopped chives ~3 g

green_bean_cup.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 cup green bean pieces ~100 g

apple_piece.basis: USDA FoodData Central household measure: 1 medium apple ~180 g

sage_tsp.basis: dried herb teaspoon ~1 g, consistent with the suite's dried-thyme/oregano refs
